section_summary: These pages document a 1935 dispute over advance notice for Japanese public vessels visiting United States ports. State and Navy officials insisted on notification through diplomatic channels, while Japanese Embassy officers explored local notification and changes to an informal arrangement covering Japan and the Philippine Islands. The section also records visits by Japanese tankers and training ships, including several arrivals without advance notice.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Kawahara on Japanese public vessels
subfiles.about: Kawahara asks whether Japanese vessels may enter American ports under a less formal notification procedure.
subfiles.summary: Kawahara submits three informal questions after confirming that naval attachés previously notified the Navy Department of tanker visits. Dooman refers them to Navy and other departments; Commander Lewis agrees to seek Navy's view.

subfiles.title: Three questions submitted by Kawahara
subfiles.about: Questions concern American practice, naval attaché notification, and a wider informal agreement.
subfiles.summary: Asks about reciprocal visits and alternatives to diplomatic notification.

subfiles.title: Navy response to Kawahara's questions
subfiles.about: Commander Zacharias states Navy's position on notification and the existing arrangement.
subfiles.summary: Navy rejects naval attaché notice alone and favors the existing arrangement.

subfiles.title: Boarding report on the NARUTO
subfiles.about: Reports the NARUTO's Honolulu call, officers, armament, and expected Japanese tanker movements.
subfiles.summary: The NARUTO arrived from Los Angeles and departed for Japan after a Honolulu call. The report lists officers, complement, and anti-aircraft guns, then gives projected calls by other tankers and a possible shift to Dutch East Indies oil supplies.

subfiles.title: Letter to van der Wyck on Japanese naval tankers
subfiles.about: Explains notification requirements and charges applicable to Japanese naval tankers.
subfiles.summary: Prior diplomatic notice is normally required. Unarmed tankers avoid entry, clearance, navigation, and tonnage charges but pay for quarantine services; pilotage is uncertain.

subfiles.title: Miura's informal notice of ERIMO itinerary
subfiles.about: Gives the ERIMO's Los Angeles and Honolulu schedule for oil, fuel, and provisions.
subfiles.summary: Provides itinerary informally while the notification procedure is disputed.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Kawahara on the ERIMO notice
subfiles.about: Dooman answers Kawahara's questions and conditionally accepts Miura's informal ERIMO letter.
subfiles.summary: Dooman conveys Navy's position and warns that accepting Miura's informal letter sets no precedent for future notices.

subfiles.title: Notice to Navy concerning ERIMO
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for ERIMO's Honolulu call.
subfiles.summary: Notifies Navy of ERIMO's April 14–16 Honolulu visit.

subfiles.title: Notice to Labor concerning ERIMO
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for ERIMO's Honolulu call.
subfiles.summary: Notifies Labor of ERIMO's April 14–16 Honolulu visit.

subfiles.title: Notice to Treasury concerning ERIMO
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for ERIMO's Honolulu call.
subfiles.summary: Notifies Treasury of ERIMO's April 14–16 Honolulu visit.

subfiles.title: Notice to Interior concerning ERIMO
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for ERIMO's Honolulu call.
subfiles.summary: Notifies Interior of ERIMO's April 14–16 Honolulu visit.

subfiles.title: Notice to War concerning ERIMO
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for ERIMO's Honolulu call.
subfiles.summary: Notifies War of ERIMO's April 14–16 Honolulu visit.

subfiles.title: Notice to Agriculture concerning ERIMO
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for ERIMO's Honolulu call.
subfiles.summary: Notifies Agriculture of ERIMO's April 14–16 Honolulu visit.

subfiles.title: Immigration response on ERIMO
subfiles.from: Deputy Commissioner, Immigration and Naturalization Service
subfiles.about: Immigration authorities will facilitate landing of persons aboard ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Honolulu district director is instructed by radio.

subfiles.title: War Department response on ERIMO
subfiles.about: Confirms Hawaiian Department instructions to extend ERIMO the usual courtesies.
subfiles.summary: War Department sent instructions by cable on April 10.

subfiles.title: Customs response on ERIMO
subfiles.to: Assistant Chief, Division of Protocol and Conferences
subfiles.about: Confirms customs authorization for ERIMO's Honolulu call.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the radiogram sent to Honolulu customs.

subfiles.title: Radiogram to Honolulu customs concerning ERIMO
subfiles.about: Authorizes usual courtesies for ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Directs customs to accommodate ERIMO's April 14–16 call.

subfiles.title: Routing question on Japanese vessel proposal
subfiles.about: Asks whether to consult Protocol and Conferences and Navy.
subfiles.summary: Seeks guidance on further consultation.

subfiles.title: Handwritten response on vessel proposal
subfiles.about: Suggests informal consultation while expressing reservations about the proposal.
subfiles.summary: Recommends informal discussion with Protocol and Conferences and Navy.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Kawahara on unarmed public vessels
subfiles.about: Kawahara proposes alternatives to diplomatic notice for Japanese unarmed public vessels.
subfiles.summary: Dooman rejects a return to consular or naval attaché notice as irregular and challenges a draft framed around reciprocity. He notes that far more Japanese tankers visit American ports than American vessels visit Japan. He offers to explore a unilateral courtesy permitting local notice, but warns of operational problems and potential ill feeling if the privilege later had to be withdrawn.

subfiles.title: Kawahara's draft reciprocal notice
subfiles.about: Proposes local consular notice for Japanese unarmed public vessels entering United States ports.
subfiles.summary: Frames local notice as reciprocal treatment for Japanese vessels.

subfiles.title: Hamilton memorandum on notification policy
subfiles.about: Recommends retaining diplomatic notification for Japanese unarmed public vessels.
subfiles.summary: Cites the general rule and advises against a Japanese exception.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Kawahara on diplomatic notification
subfiles.about: Dooman rejects local notice and discusses possible termination of the informal arrangement.
subfiles.summary: Kawahara disputes the description of Japan's longstanding notification practice as irregular. Dooman insists on the rule used for other foreign vessels and says termination of the Japan–Philippines arrangement would cause little inconvenience.

subfiles.title: File note on Navy letter about reciprocal timing
subfiles.about: Points to a Navy letter on unequal notification times for American and Japanese port visits.
subfiles.summary: Cross-references a March 1935 Navy letter.

subfiles.title: Routing memorandum on ending the informal arrangement
subfiles.about: War and Navy have no objection to terminating the reciprocal arrangement.
subfiles.summary: Requests guidance on telling Kawahara; handwritten note records a telephone reply.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Kawahara on proposed termination
subfiles.about: Kawahara previews Japan's intention to require advance notice on both sides.
subfiles.summary: Kawahara says the Embassy expects to terminate the arrangement formally. Dooman asks War and Navy whether they want it continued.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy notice for SUNOSAKI and SATA
subfiles.about: Requests approval and courtesies for SUNOSAKI and SATA at Honolulu and Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: Supplies June–July tanker itineraries and asks about crew landing.

subfiles.title: Copy of Japanese Embassy tanker notice
subfiles.about: Duplicates the SUNOSAKI and SATA itinerary and request.
subfiles.summary: File copy of the June 6 Embassy note.

subfiles.title: Telegram to California governor on tankers
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for SUNOSAKI and SATA at Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: Gives the expected Los Angeles call dates.

subfiles.title: Reply to Japanese Ambassador on tankers
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the tanker notice and agrees to visits and customary courtesies.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the SUNOSAKI and SATA schedules, approves the proposed calls and crew landing, and promises customary facilities.

subfiles.title: Notice to Labor on SUNOSAKI and SATA
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for the tankers' Honolulu and Los Angeles visits.
subfiles.summary: Confirms the June 7 telephone notice and gives schedules.

subfiles.title: Notice to Navy on SUNOSAKI and SATA
subfiles.about: Confirms the tanker notice and requests customary facilities.
subfiles.summary: Repeats both vessels' Honolulu and Los Angeles schedules.

subfiles.title: Notice to War on SUNOSAKI and SATA
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for the tankers' scheduled calls.
subfiles.summary: Confirms the June 7 telephone notice and gives schedules.

subfiles.title: Notice to Treasury on SUNOSAKI and SATA
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for the tankers' scheduled calls.
subfiles.summary: Confirms the June 7 telephone notice and gives schedules.

subfiles.title: Notice to Agriculture on SUNOSAKI and SATA
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for the tankers' scheduled calls.
subfiles.summary: Confirms the June 7 telephone notice and gives schedules.

subfiles.title: Notice to Interior on SUNOSAKI and SATA
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for the tankers' scheduled calls.
subfiles.summary: Confirms the June 7 telephone notice and gives schedules.

subfiles.title: Customs transmittal on tanker visits
subfiles.to: Assistant Chief, Division of Protocol and Conferences
subfiles.about: Encloses telegrams to customs collectors about two Japanese tankers.
subfiles.summary: Forwards instructions to Los Angeles and Honolulu.

subfiles.title: Telegram to Los Angeles customs
subfiles.about: Orders customary courtesies for SUNOSAKI and SATA.
subfiles.summary: Specifies the Los Angeles dates for both ships.

subfiles.title: Telegram to Honolulu customs
subfiles.about: Orders customary courtesies for SUNOSAKI and SATA.
subfiles.summary: Specifies both ships' Honolulu dates.

subfiles.title: Immigration response on SUNOSAKI and SATA
subfiles.about: Immigration officers will extend lawful courtesies to both tanker crews.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the planned Honolulu and Los Angeles calls.

subfiles.title: Navy notice of unannounced NIPPON MARU arrival
subfiles.about: Reports NIPPON MARU's San Diego arrival without advance notice.
subfiles.summary: Navy had received no prior notification of the training ship.

subfiles.title: State reply on unannounced public vessel visits
subfiles.about: Explains the circular requiring prior diplomatic notice for foreign public vessels.
subfiles.summary: Responding to Navy's NIPPON MARU report, State encloses its July 13 circular to foreign missions and expects better notice of future visits.

subfiles.title: Excerpt recommending discussion with Japanese Ambassador
subfiles.about: Recommends raising unannounced TAISEI MARU and HAKUYO MARU movements with the Ambassador.
subfiles.summary: Urges strict diplomatic notice for Japanese public vessels.

subfiles.title: Circular note to chiefs of mission
subfiles.about: Requests advance diplomatic notice of foreign public vessel calls, subject to special arrangements.
subfiles.summary: Sets out the general prior-notification rule.

subfiles.title: War response on SUNOSAKI and SATA
subfiles.about: Confirms military authorities were told to extend the tankers customary courtesies.
subfiles.summary: Commands in California and Hawaii received radio instructions.

subfiles.title: File note on Ensenada despatch
subfiles.about: Cross-references a despatch on NIPPON MARU's Ensenada stay and expected San Diego arrival.
subfiles.summary: Points to despatch 999 in another file.

subfiles.title: Consular despatch on NIPPON MARU at Ensenada
subfiles.from: William Smale, American Consul at Ensenada
subfiles.about: Describes NIPPON MARU's Ensenada visit and expected San Diego call.
subfiles.summary: The consul reports the ship's arrival, its captain's courtesy visit, local hospitality, and a banquet held by the Japanese colony. He expects the vessel to reach San Diego around June 14 and recounts his remarks welcoming the crew and cadets.

subfiles.title: File note on Protocol memorandum
subfiles.about: Cross-references a memorandum proposing a circular notice after NIPPON MARU's expected call.
subfiles.summary: Points to a July Protocol and Conferences memorandum.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Kawahara on public vessel categories
subfiles.about: Kawahara suggests different notice rules for Navy-registered and other public vessels.
subfiles.summary: Japan now seeks diplomatic notice only for Navy-registered vessels and local notice for all other public vessels. Kawahara cannot yet define the latter category and promises possible clarification.

subfiles.title: Navy inquiry on TAISEI MARU at San Diego
subfiles.about: Reports TAISEI MARU's unannounced arrival and requests its planned departure date.
subfiles.summary: Navy identifies the training ship as a Japanese public vessel.

subfiles.title: Navy follow-up on TAISEI MARU
subfiles.about: Reports TAISEI MARU's departure for Hilo and asks about future calls.
subfiles.summary: Navy still lacks advance notice of the Hilo visit.

subfiles.title: Telephone memorandum on TAISEI MARU itinerary
subfiles.about: Records Kawahara's informal Hilo arrival and departure dates for TAISEI MARU.
subfiles.summary: Kawahara says the ship will sail directly to Japan.

subfiles.title: State reply to Navy on TAISEI MARU
subfiles.about: Relays an informal Hilo itinerary and states Japan was reminded of notice requirements.
subfiles.summary: State has no official notification but says the Embassy informally supplied the Hilo dates. State also told the Embassy that future Japanese public vessel visits require prior diplomatic notice.

subfiles.title: Memorandum on TAISEI MARU's San Diego arrival
subfiles.about: Records Navy's report that TAISEI MARU arrived without diplomatic notice.
subfiles.summary: Describes its public status and merchant cadet training role.

subfiles.title: Memorandum recommending action on unannounced ships
subfiles.about: Recommends raising TAISEI MARU and HAKUYO MARU with the Japanese Ambassador.
subfiles.summary: The memorandum cites the July 13 circular, repeated unannounced Japanese arrivals, and an unanswered inquiry about HAKUYO MARU in Alaska. It proposes a senior-level reminder that Japan must comply with the diplomatic notice rule.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Ambassador Saito
subfiles.about: Raises unannounced Japanese public vessel entries with Ambassador Saito.
subfiles.summary: Hornbeck summarizes the issue and gives Saito an aide-mémoire.

subfiles.title: Routing note on proposed Japanese arrangement
subfiles.about: Reports Navy's likely opposition to Japan's proposed arrangement.
subfiles.summary: Navy is expected to reject the proposal.

subfiles.title: Memorandum on Kawahara's written proposal
subfiles.about: Records receipt of Japan's proposal to extend local notification.
subfiles.summary: Dooman promises consultation with interested departments.

subfiles.title: Japanese statement identifying public vessel categories
subfiles.about: Seeks local notice for non-Navy Japanese public vessels throughout United States territory.
subfiles.summary: Lists nautical, navigation, fishing, and agricultural vessels.

subfiles.title: State request for Navy's opinion
subfiles.about: Asks Navy how State should answer Japan's local-notification proposal.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Kawahara's informal statement.

subfiles.title: Copy of Japanese public vessel statement
subfiles.about: Repeats the proposed local-notification rule for non-Navy public vessels.
subfiles.summary: Copy enclosed with State's August 28 note.

subfiles.title: Memorandum rejecting Japan's proposed revision
subfiles.about: Dooman informs Kawahara that the proposed revision is unacceptable.
subfiles.summary: Kawahara says Japan will soon terminate the informal arrangement.

subfiles.title: Navy opposition to local notification
subfiles.about: Rejects local notice for Japanese non-Navy public vessels.
subfiles.summary: Navy urges strict adherence to diplomatic notification, including for Alaska and the Aleutians.
